original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC: Solutions containing 10–20 μM of protein were loaded into Malvern MicroCal PEAQ-ITC calorimeter cell. original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Fig. 7. Thermodynamics of Hsp90 binding to selected compounds. ITC experiments were performed in 50 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, pH 7.5, buffer at 37 °C. (A) Selected ITC data with Hsp90 N-terminal domain proteins. Inset charts show the raw data that was baseline-corrected by NITPIC software [31]. The shown HPIT-02 (4ad) and IV-15 (2ac) compounds only differ in their 5-membered ring. First row of subfigures show data for HPIT-03 (4ac) compound, second row of subfigures show data for IV-15 (2ac) compound. The columns of plots show data for Hsp90αN (blue), Hsp90αN (S52A) (red), Hsp90βN (green) proteins respectively. (B) Bar charts of the protein-ligand binding energetics as determined using ITC. Colours represent different binding energies: grey – Gibbs energy (ΔbG), orange – enthalpy (ΔbH), purple – entropy (-TΔbS). original_paragraph.Table 2: ITC data of protein–ligand binding energetics and affinity. Experiments were performed in 50 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, pH 7.5, buffer at 37 °C temperature. All experiments were repeated at least three times. 95 % confidence intervals.
original_paragraph.Table 2 data: The table contains the following data for the ITC experiments: protein (Hsp90αN, Hsp90αN (S52A), Hsp90βN), ligand (e.g., HPIT-02 4ad, HPIT-03 4ac, IV-11 2aa, etc.), Kd (μM), ΔbG (kJ/mol), ΔbH (kJ/mol), and -TΔbS (kJ/mol).
